about: A second held-out set for the safety check (core/moderation.py), written on 9 November 2026 after the checker began reading every message, before anything was run on it: many everyday things neurodivergent people say, to catch over-moderation, and crises said plainly and in emoji. Run once, untuned, for an honest number (python -m scripts.eval_moderation --set holdout2). Don't tune on these; write new ones instead. First run, untuned: 25/25, over-moderated 0, missed 0. Two context rules were added afterwards for misses in the other sets (grief, legal things); still 25/25. Write a new set for the next honest number.
